title: A protected Loom asset left on the default open download policy hands its original to anyone with its id
detail:
FOUND 2026-10-05 in the scan-six read of LIVE-578 / LIVE-580 (0fa4462, d9d06b7). download_policy defaults to `open` (20260920000000_library_dam.sql) and protecting an asset does not tighten it; admitDownload returns early on `open` without asking isProtected, and download-door.test.ts pins a signed-out caller getting a signed URL for protectedAsset('open'). withLoomProofs sends the asset id to every picker user, so anyone, signed out included, can GET /api/library/download/<id> and receive a one-minute signed attachment of the master: LIVE-580 says a protected image is 'never its original'.

WHY IT IS A RULING: ADR-1594 deliberately made protection and policy independent knobs ('Each is optional and independent'). Pick one: (a) the door reads protected+open as `members`; (b) as `staff`; (c) protecting an asset sets download_policy to staff unless the operator chose otherwise; (d) keep as is and say in the drawer that Protected does not gate downloads.

source.ref: found 2026-10-05 by the scan-six adversarial read of the 2026-09-28..30 merges

verify.note: Fails until the door or the protect move considers protection when the policy is open. If the ruling is (d), close it with that note and a probe on the drawer copy.
